<hr>
=== Usage ===

Add {{tl|deletion}} or {{tl|del}} to the top of a page

Adding a pipe ( | ) after either command will change the default text to appear instead 
as the editor's "reasoning" for the deletion.

For example, <nowiki>{{del|This is a sample deletion request}}</nowiki> will appear as...
{{del|This is a sample deletion request|cat=nocat}}Adding a second pipe, <nowiki>{{del|This is a sample deletion request.|40}}</nowiki>, will allow you to set a custom width...
{{del|This is a sample deletion request.|40|cat=nocat}}

</noinclude>
